tables.name: reconciliation_proposals
columns: import_run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_runs(import_run_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
source_observation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES source_observations(source_observation_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT

proposal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(proposal_kind IN ('rfc_create_or_adopt','rfc_source_projection','rfc_customer_reconciliation','sr_rfc_link_candidate','wfm_create_or_adopt','wfm_source_projection','wfm_provisional_rfc','wfm_provisional_eligibility','wfm_plan_reconciliation','wfm_competing_attempt_review'))
target_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(target_kind IN ('rfc','wfm','customer_organization','sr_rfc_relationship','task_plan','activity_lineage'))
risk_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(risk_class IN ('low','medium','high','blocked'))
proposal_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(proposal_state IN ('pending','accepted','rejected','deferred','superseded','no_change'))
revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0)
CHECK((proposal_state='pending' AND decided_at_utc IS NULL) OR (proposal_state<>'pending' AND decided_at_utc IS NOT NULL))
rules: one proposal represents the smallest independently explainable/revalidatable target mutation scope
proposal fingerprint binds exact source observation/change set/profile versions; base_state token binds authoritative current target state used to calculate the proposal
proposal is non-authoritative until accepted through owning-domain command
blocked proposals cannot be accepted; no_change proposals cause no domain command
proposal rows retain source presence regardless of disposition

tables.name: reconciliation_proposal_changes
columns: reconciliation_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reconciliation_proposals(reconciliation_proposal_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
change_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(change_kind IN ('create','set','clear','link','unlink','adopt','candidate','conflict'))
value_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(value_kind IN ('none','text','controlled','instant','duration_seconds','identity'))
source_observation_field_id TEXT REFERENCES source_observation_fields(source_observation_field_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK((value_kind IN ('none','text','controlled','identity') AND before_integer IS NULL AND after_integer IS NULL) OR value_kind IN ('instant','duration_seconds'))
rules: changes are typed/bounded; no unrestricted generic JSON change object exists
before/after values include only minimal review-safe allowlisted values required to explain the proposed mutation
relationship candidates use immutable/business identities rather than copied entity snapshots

tables.name: proposal_dispositions
columns: reconciliation_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reconciliation_proposals(reconciliation_proposal_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN ('accepted','rejected','deferred','superseded','no_change'))
decision_origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision_origin IN ('operator','replay_engine','recovery','system_no_change'))
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: accepted disposition and owning-domain mutation commit in the same UnitOfWork; if domain mutation fails no accepted disposition remains
a stale proposal is superseded rather than rewritten to a new base state

tables.name: proposal_equivalence_decisions
columns: decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(decision IN ('rejected','deferred'))
source_proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reconciliation_proposals(reconciliation_proposal_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
command_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES command_receipts(command_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
rules: bounded equivalence evidence may suppress redisplaying a materially unchanged rejected/deferred proposal
newer source chronology alone does not invalidate equivalence when material proposal inputs are identical
material input change or explicit reconsideration creates a new review opportunity; prior decision remains immutable

index_rules: PRIMARY KEY(reconciliation_proposal_id,ordinal) already covers the proposal FK on reconciliation_proposal_changes; no redundant duplicate proposal-FK index is created
nullable FK indexes are full indexes rather than active/nonnull partial indexes so LLD-01 FK coverage verification can reason over all persisted rows
protection: proposal changes and dispositions/equivalence rows reject UPDATE/DELETE
proposal UPDATE permits only governed pending->accepted/rejected/deferred/superseded/no_change terminal transition fields; terminal proposals reject further UPDATE
all accepted domain-facing decisions use current authoritative base-state revalidation inside the same UnitOfWork
